settings.shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts

settings.shortcuts.handsFreeDesc: Best for talking at length: press once to start, press again to stop. Nothing to hold down.
settings.shortcuts.handsFreeHelp:
Which keys can I use?
A single common key (Right Alt, Caps Lock, F1–F24), a modifier + key combination, or a mouse side or middle button. Windows-reserved combinations that lock or switch windows or open system UI can't be bound.

What happens if I bind a mouse button?
Binding a side button takes over its Back and Forward function. Binding the middle button may break opening links in new tabs and autoscroll.
settings.shortcuts.pttDesc: Best for short bursts: recording starts once the whole combination is held down, and stops as soon as you release any key.
settings.shortcuts.pttHelp:
Which keys can I use?
A single common key (Caps Lock, F1–F24), a modifier + key combination, a modifier-only combination such as Ctrl + Win, or a mouse side or middle button. Windows-reserved combinations that lock or switch windows or open system UI can't be bound.

What are F13–F24?
Windows knows these keys, but keyboards rarely have them, so they almost never clash with other programs. A programmable keyboard or an external device with buttons can emit F13–F24 as a dedicated recording trigger; you can also remap a key you never use with a tool like PowerToys Keyboard Manager.

Do modifier-only combinations affect Windows?
Those keys still reach Windows, and some combinations may also open the Start menu. Try your choice in the apps you use most.

What happens if I bind a mouse button?
Binding a side button takes over its Back and Forward function. Binding the middle button may break opening links in new tabs and autoscroll.

settings.contextAware.descSelection: After selecting text with the mouse, you can ask to translate, shorten, or rewrite it. SayForge replaces the original with the result.
settings.contextAware.infoFunction: How it works: SayForge reads text from the current text box through Windows UI Automation, without screenshots or OCR. When recording starts, it reads up to 500 characters before the cursor and 300 after it.
settings.contextAware.infoUsage: When no text is selected with the mouse: the captured text is sent to AI with this transcription as context. SayForge still uses the current AI cleanup prompt so the new tone, terminology, and formatting fit naturally.
settings.contextAware.infoPrinciple: When text is selected with the mouse: SayForge uses the separate prompt below and follows your request to translate, shorten, rewrite, or ask about the selected content, then replaces the original with the result.
settings.contextAware.infoAria: Learn what context awareness does, how to use it, and how it works
settings.contextAware.promptDesc: If no text is selected with the mouse, SayForge keeps using the current AI cleanup prompt. If text is selected, it uses the prompt below to edit that text according to what you say.

dict.intro: Hotwords help speech recognition get proper nouns and industry terms right.
dict.caveat: Hotwords only raise the **chance of a match** — they don't guarantee it, and **more is not better**. Recognition services differ in how they handle hotwords; what your current setup does is explained below.
dict.delivery.sent: **The active chat protocol sends hotwords as context.** This can improve recognition but does not guarantee a match.
dict.delivery.notSent: **The active protocol does not send hotwords.** SayForge's multipart /audio/transcriptions request uses its prompt for punctuation.
dict.delivery.undecided: The API protocol for this service hasn't been detected yet, so whether hotwords apply is only known after the first recognition or a connection test.
dict.delivery.undecidedDeclaration: **SayForge hasn't recorded how this recognition service handles hotwords**, so it can't tell whether they will be sent this time. That's a gap on our side rather than a problem with your setup, and recognizing again won't change it — report it and we'll fill it in.
dict.delivery.undecidedQueryFailed: **SayForge couldn't read how the current service handles hotwords** — likely an older build or an internal call that failed. Recognizing again won't change this; try restarting SayForge, and if it persists, update to the latest version or report it.
dict.delivery.clientCap: You have **{count}** hotwords and SayForge sends at most **{cap}** per request; the rest are not sent. This is SayForge's own send limit, not a server restriction.
dict.delivery.fallbackHint: Use text replacements for reliable corrections. Replacements and local spacing restoration work with AI cleanup turned off.
dict.delivery.spacingRestore: Hotwords are still used to restore spelling after recognition (for example turning "Say Forge" back into "SayForge"). That step needs no extra setup.
dict.countHint: You have **{count}** hotwords. **More is not better** — keep the list to terms you actually use.

dict.orderHint: Category order sets hotword priority: when the total exceeds the limit the list is cut from the bottom, and some models only use the first part of it. Drag the handle at the top left of a card to move a category up.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.aiDisabledHint: AI cleanup is off, so cleanup presets and other AI-dependent features won't run. Turn it on from the top right of Home or the AI cleanup page in the sidebar.
diagnostics.faq.insertQuestion: The transcript wasn't inserted after recognition finished
diagnostics.faq.insert1: **Click the text box first** so the cursor sits inside it.
diagnostics.faq.insert2: **Don't switch windows while holding the shortcut**: the cursor must still be in the text box when you release it.
diagnostics.faq.insert3: **Nothing works anywhere**: security software is usually the cause. Add SayForge to its trusted list.
diagnostics.faq.insert4: **Games and installers fail**: they run as administrator, so run SayForge as administrator too.
diagnostics.faq.insert5: **Only one app fails**: SayForge can't recognize its text box yet. Use the copy button on the card to grab the text.
diagnostics.faq.insertFooter: Still stuck? Use "Report a problem" below and pick "Text not inserted".
